_readme: Curated free courses from well-known platforms (part 1 of 2). The import_resources command loads every data/curated*.json file.

entries.title: Python for Everybody Specialization
entries.description: Learn to program and analyze data with Python — variables, loops, files, web scraping, and databases.

entries.title: CS50's Introduction to Programming with Python
entries.description: A free intro to programming using Python — functions, conditionals, loops, exceptions, tests, file I/O, and OOP.

entries.title: Introduction to Computer Science and Programming in Python
entries.description: MIT 6.0001 — lectures, slides, and problem sets. Computational thinking in pure Python.

entries.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python
entries.description: The famous free book teaching practical Python automation — Excel, PDFs, web scraping, and bots.

entries.title: W3Schools Python Tutorial
entries.description: Interactive Python reference with try-it editors — syntax, data structures, classes, exercises.

entries.title: LearnPython.org Interactive Tutorial
entries.description: Run-as-you-read Python lessons with exercises — variables, loops, functions and classes.

entries.title: Python for Data Science
entries.description: NPTEL certification course — Python, Jupyter, NumPy, Pandas, and plotting for data work.

entries.title: Scientific Computing with Python
entries.description: Free certification track — Python fundamentals plus projects like an arithmetic formatter and probability calculator.

entries.title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
entries.description: Harvard's flagship intro to CS — C, Python, SQL, and JavaScript with legendary problem sets.

entries.title: The Odin Project — Foundations
entries.description: Free open-source curriculum — web basics, Git, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals with real projects.

entries.title: The Odin Project — Full Stack JavaScript
entries.description: Complete full-stack path — advanced JS, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and deployment.

entries.title: The Odin Project — Full Stack Ruby on Rails
entries.description: Backend-heavy path with Ruby, Rails, PostgreSQL, and production deployment.

entries.title: Responsive Web Design Certification
entries.description: HTML5, CSS3, flexbox, grid, and accessibility — build 5 certification projects along the way.

entries.title: JavaScript Algorithms and Data Structures
entries.description: Core JavaScript, regexes, OOP, functional programming, and algorithm challenges.

entries.title: Front End Development Libraries
entries.description: Bootstrap, jQuery, Sass, and React — build a random-quote machine and a Markdown previewer.

entries.title: JavaScript.info — The Modern JavaScript Tutorial
entries.description: The most complete free JavaScript reference — basics to advanced browser APIs and events.

entries.title: MDN — Learn Web Development
entries.description: Mozilla's structured learning area — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, accessibility, and server-side basics.

entries.title: Learn Git Branching (Interactive)
entries.description: Visual, game-like Git trainer — commits, merges, rebases, and remote workflows.

entries.title: CS50W: Web Programming with Python and JavaScript
entries.description: Django, SQL, JavaScript, React, testing, and deployment — CS50's advanced web track.

entries.title: Khan Academy — Computer Programming
entries.description: Draw, animate, and build with JavaScript — a gentle intro with instant visual feedback.

entries.title: Khan Academy — Computers and the Internet
entries.description: How the internet works — protocols, packets, DNS, HTTP, and web security fundamentals.
